text: Large multi-feature requests are split into a foundation issue plus one issue per feature, each linked to the foundation and the original request.
child-page parent-facing Settings sit behind a simple-sum parent gate and are reached via a quiet gear icon on the main menu only, never inside activities.

child-page menu configuration (enabled activities and their order) is stored as one full ordered list of all activities; disabled ones keep their position and unknown/new activities are appended enabled; disabled activities are unreachable via history or hash routes.

child-page new activities each get their own issue with a menu tile, Settings activity-list entry (enabled, appended at the end), reduced-motion support and a neutral no-failure interaction model; menu layout for many tiles is a separate foundation issue.

child-page README is written in English with Polish activity names; every new activity must be added to the README Activities section with a short description, and the activity count in the intro must stay correct.

child-page learning activities have no wrong answers or failure feedback: incorrect moves drift back gently, success is only a soft glow, nothing is scored or stored, meaning is carried by pictures/shapes (numerals only for counting), with a keyboard alternative and a non-colour cue where colour matters.
